# Pakistan Tax Calculator

> Free, FBR-rate-accurate tax calculators for Pakistan: income tax, withholding tax, sales tax (federal and provincial), property valuation, and property transaction expenses, covering Tax Year 2025-26 and 2026-27.

Pakistan Tax Calculator (paktaxcalculator.net) provides browser-based calculators built on official FBR (Federal Board of Revenue) rate cards, the Finance Act 2025, the Finance Act 2026-27, and provincial revenue authority publications. All figures are sourced from official notifications and reviewed regularly. This is an independent, informational resource and not affiliated with FBR or any government body.

## Calculators

- [Income Tax Calculator](https://paktaxcalculator.net/income-tax.html): Salaried, business/AOP, and company tax slabs and liability under the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001.
- [Withholding Tax (WHT) Calculator](https://paktaxcalculator.net/withholding-tax.html): Withholding tax on goods, services, contracts, and dividends for filers and non-filers.
- [Invoice Withholding — All in One](https://paktaxcalculator.net/invoice-withholding.html): GST, provincial sales tax, and withholding tax combined on a single supplier invoice.
- [Sales Tax on Goods (GST)](https://paktaxcalculator.net/sales-tax-gst.html): Federal General Sales Tax rates on goods.
- [Sales Tax Withholding](https://paktaxcalculator.net/sales-tax-withholding.html): Withholding on the GST portion of an invoice.
- [FBR Property Valuation Directory & Calculator](https://paktaxcalculator.net/fbr-property-valuation.html): Official FBR/DC property valuation rates for 46+ verified cities across Pakistan, with an integrated property expense calculator (stamp duty, registration fee, 236C/236K withholding tax, Capital Gains Tax).
- [Property Expense Calculator](https://paktaxcalculator.net/property-expense-calculator.html): Stamp duty, registration fee, 236C/236K withholding tax, and Capital Gains Tax on property transactions.
